issue.title: Extend the orphaned-scope reaper to sase-monitor and sase-proc scopes

task_type_fields.proposal: Extend the orphaned-scope backstop beyond sase-agent-* scopes so a dead sase-monitor or sase-proc owner cannot leave its scope running. Each scope family needs its own owner-process signature, the same way the agent reaper recognizes run_agent_runner.py and systemd-run, and must keep spared shared daemons alive.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1i4 (plan:202610/agent_scope_leak_reaping.md) explicitly left this out of scope. The agent reaper's live-owner check is run_agent_runner.py, which does not identify monitor or proc owners. Proposed by that plan's out-of-scope list, not by a defect in the agent reaper.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1i4's plan lists extending the orphaned-scope reaper to sase-monitor and sase-proc scopes as follow-up work, because those scopes need their own owner-process signatures. No existing task tracks it.

payload.description: Out of scope for the agent-scope reaper; owner signatures differ
Confirm the feature follow-up fields before marking it ready
